description: Intended gateway JWT verification (verify_jwt) for every Edge Function. Existing functions match production project izlrxenomerfeqhmlyre as audited read-only on 2026-11-03 (supabase functions list). Checked by scripts/deploy/check-function-jwt.mjs against supabase/config.toml (and, with --remote, against a hosted project). Change a value here only together with config.toml, after confirming the function authorizes its callers itself.

get-collection-item-image-signed-url.why: anonymous viewers of public folders; checks any session itself

get-folder-cover-signed-url.why: anonymous viewers of public folders; checks any session itself

get-registry-snapshot-image-url.why: anonymous viewers; checks any session itself

admin-media-quarantine.why: admin only (Phase 2B M2.3c); checks admin_users and the account lifecycle itself

admin-media-restore.why: admin only (Phase 2B M2.3c); checks admin_users and the account lifecycle itself

admin-snapshot-reconcile.why: admin only (Phase 2B M2.3d); checks admin_users and the account lifecycle itself

account-maintenance.why: called by pg_cron/pg_net with ACCOUNT_MAINTENANCE_SECRET (not a JWT); checks it itself

account-monitor.why: called by pg_cron/pg_net and operators with ACCOUNT_MAINTENANCE_SECRET; checks it itself

account-deletion-status.why: callers' accounts and sessions are gone; requires a single-purpose status capability on every request, answers processing/completed/failed only

account-deletion.why: signed-in callers only; signed-out completion is confirmed through account-deletion-status

account-export.why: signed-in collectors only; export expiry and abandoned-job cleanup run inside account-maintenance, so no server key ever needs to pass this gateway

testflight-feedback-webhook.why: deployed outside this repo; never deploy with --prune, which would delete it
